ex.en: Her paper was published in a medical journal.
ex.zh: 她的論文刊登在一份醫學期刊上。

ex.en: Scientists read journals to keep up with new research.
ex.zh: 科學家閱讀期刊以掌握最新研究。

journal.en: a magazine with serious articles about a particular subject

ex.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸每天都寫日記。

ex.en: Do you keep a journal?
ex.zh: 你記日記嗎？

journal.en: a daily written record of what you do or think

ex.en: I jog in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上會去慢跑。

ex.en: He may be jogging around the park.
ex.zh: 他可能正在公園附近慢跑。

ex.en: I think jogging is good exercise.
ex.zh: 我認為慢跑是很好的運動。

jog.en: to run slowly and steadily for exercise

ex.en: The man next door said he goes for a jog every morning.
ex.zh: 隔壁的男士說他每天早上都去慢跑。

ex.en: Let's go for a jog after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去慢跑吧。

jog.en: a slow, steady run for exercise

jog.zh: jog one's memory：喚起某人的記憶

ex.en: This photo might jog your memory.
ex.zh: 這張照片也許能喚起你的記憶。

ex.en: Let me jog your memory: we met at last year's conference.
ex.zh: 我提醒你一下：我們去年在研討會上見過。

ex.en: Tom studies journalism in Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆在波士頓念新聞系。

ex.en: She has worked in journalism for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在新聞業工作了十年。

journalism.en: the work of collecting and writing news for newspapers, TV or websites, or the study of it

ex.en: They worked jointly on this project.
ex.zh: 他們一起進行過這個專案。

ex.en: Euro 2012 is being hosted jointly by Poland and Ukraine.
ex.zh: 2012 年歐洲盃足球賽由波蘭和烏克蘭共同主辦。

ex.en: The account is jointly owned by Tom and Amy.
ex.zh: 這個帳戶由 Tom 和 Amy 共同持有。

jointly.en: together with another person or group

ex.en: Today, many people worry about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如今很多人擔心失業。

ex.en: Tom is thinking about applying for a better-paying job.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在考慮應徵一份薪水更高的工作。

ex.en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
ex.zh: 電腦產業有很多工作機會。

job.en: the work that a person does to earn money

ex.en: Give us the tools, and we'll finish the job.
ex.zh: 給我們工具，我們就能完成工作。

ex.en: Cleaning the kitchen is my job.
ex.zh: 打掃廚房是我的工作。

job.en: a piece of work or duty that someone has to do

job.zh: good job / do a great job：做得好

ex.en: Good job on the presentation!
ex.zh: 簡報做得很好！

ex.en: You did a great job.
ex.zh: 你做得非常好。

job.en: used to praise someone for doing something well

ex.en: Sam joined the army when he was eighteen.
ex.zh: 山姆十八歲時從軍。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不用繳會費。

ex.en: Would you like to join our team?
ex.zh: 你想加入我們的團隊嗎？

join.en: to become a member of a group or organization

ex.en: It is a pity that you can't join us.
ex.zh: 你不能跟我們一起來，真可惜。

ex.en: Do you mind if I join you for lunch?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你一起吃午餐嗎？

join.en: to do an activity together with other people

ex.en: The bridge joins the two towns.
ex.zh: 這座橋連接兩個城鎮。

ex.en: Join the two pieces with glue.
ex.zh: 用膠水把兩片黏在一起。

join.en: to connect two things so they become one

ex.en: We are going on a journey next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月要去旅行。

ex.en: Their journey was delayed because of the train.
ex.zh: 他們的旅程因為火車而延誤了。

ex.en: I made use of the maps during my journey.
ex.zh: 我在旅途中用了地圖。

journey.en: a trip from one place to another, usually a long one

ex.en: My joints ache when it gets cold.
ex.zh: 天氣變冷時，我的關節會痛。

ex.en: Swimming is good for your joints.
ex.zh: 游泳對關節很好。

joint.en: a place where two bones meet, or where two parts are connected

ex.en: The two companies launched a joint project.
ex.zh: 兩家公司推出了一項合作專案。

ex.en: We opened a joint bank account.
ex.zh: 我們開了一個聯名銀行帳戶。

joint.en: shared by or done by two or more people

ex.en: They formed a joint venture in Vietnam.
ex.zh: 他們在越南成立了一家合資企業。

ex.en: The joint venture will start production next year.
ex.zh: 這家合資企業明年將開始生產。

joint.en: a business project in which two or more companies work together

ex.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.
ex.zh: 我喜歡她聽我講笑話時笑的樣子。

ex.en: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
ex.zh: 我們都被他的笑話逗得很開心。

ex.en: Mr Smith always begins his lectures with a joke.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生總是用一個笑話開始他的課。

joke.en: something said or done to make people laugh

ex.en: Tell her that I am just joking with her.
ex.zh: 告訴她我只是在跟她開玩笑。

ex.en: You must be joking! I can't find my passport!
ex.zh: 不會吧！我的護照不見了！

joke.en: to say funny things that are not meant seriously

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們嘗到了勝利的喜悅。

ex.en: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.
ex.zh: 他聽到那個好消息，高興得跳了起來。

ex.en: Language learning brings a lot of joy in our life.
ex.zh: 學語言為我們的生活帶來許多樂趣。

joy.zh: 樂事、令人開心的人事物

ex.en: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
ex.zh: 美好的事物是永恆的喜悅。

ex.en: It's a joy to work with such a great team.
ex.zh: 能和這麼棒的團隊共事真是一大樂事。

joy.en: a person or thing that gives you great pleasure

joining.zh: 參加、加入（join 的現在分詞／動名詞）

ex.en: They will not accept any excuses for not joining the meeting.
ex.zh: 他們不接受任何不出席會議的藉口。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不用繳會費。

ex.en: Thank you for joining us on today's call.
ex.zh: 謝謝大家參加今天的電話會議。

joining.en: to become a member of a group or take part in an activity

ex.en: I saw a joyful smile on his face.
ex.zh: 在他的臉上我看到了快樂的笑容。

ex.en: The wedding was a joyful occasion for the whole family.
ex.zh: 婚禮對全家人來說是個歡樂的場合。

joyful.en: full of happiness, or causing happiness

ex.en: The town held a joyous celebration after the team won.
ex.zh: 球隊獲勝後，全鎮舉行了歡樂的慶祝活動。

ex.en: They sang joyous songs all night.
ex.zh: 他們整晚都在唱歡樂的歌。

joyous.en: very happy and full of celebration

ex.en: I want to be a journalist.
ex.zh: 我想成為記者。

ex.en: My boyfriend is a journalist.
ex.zh: 我男朋友是個記者。

ex.en: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
ex.zh: 谷先生與其說是學者，不如說是新聞工作者。

journalist.en: a person whose job is to write or report the news

ex.en: There's a job opening in our marketing department.
ex.zh: 我們行銷部有一個職缺。

ex.en: I saw the job opening on the company's website.
ex.zh: 我在公司網站上看到這個職缺。

job opening.en: a position of work that a company wants to fill

ex.en: The two firms established a joint venture in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 兩家公司在台灣成立了一家合資企業。

ex.en: The joint venture will develop new medical equipment.
ex.zh: 這家合資企業將開發新的醫療設備。

joint venture.en: a business project in which two or more companies work together

ex.en: John is a very common name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 約翰是英語系國家非常常見的名字。

ex.en: John and his sister walk to school together.
ex.zh: 約翰和他的妹妹一起走路上學。

ex.en: Our new classmate's name is John.
ex.zh: 我們的新同學叫約翰。

ex.en: Jones is a very common family name in Wales.
ex.zh: 瓊斯是威爾斯非常常見的姓氏。

ex.en: Mr. Jones teaches history at the local high school.
ex.zh: 瓊斯先生在當地高中教歷史。

ex.en: Joe is a short and common name for Joseph.
ex.zh: 喬是約瑟夫一個簡短又常見的暱稱。

ex.en: Joe made coffee for everyone before the meeting started.
ex.zh: 會議開始前，喬幫大家煮了咖啡。

ex.en: Johnson is a common family name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 約翰遜是英語國家常見的姓氏。

ex.en: Dr. Johnson will see you in a few minutes.
ex.zh: 約翰遜醫生幾分鐘後就會看你。

ex.en: Joseph is a traditional name for boys in English.
ex.zh: 約瑟夫是英語中傳統的男孩名字。

ex.en: Joseph teaches music at a small school.
ex.zh: 約瑟夫在一所小學校教音樂。

ex.en: In the Bible, Joseph is one of the sons of Jacob.
ex.zh: 在聖經裡，約瑟是雅各的兒子之一。

ex.en: The story of Joseph is told in the book of Genesis.
ex.zh: 約瑟的故事記載在創世記中。

ex.en: Joan has lived in the same house for thirty years.
ex.zh: 瓊在同一棟房子裡住了三十年。

ex.en: Joan gave me a ride to the station.
ex.zh: 瓊載我去了車站。

ex.en: Jonathan is a name that comes from Hebrew.
ex.zh: 喬納森這個名字源自希伯來文。

ex.en: Jonathan is a popular name for boys in many countries.
ex.zh: 喬納森在許多國家都是受歡迎的男孩名字。

ex.en: Johnny is a short, friendly form of the name John.
ex.zh: 強尼是約翰這個名字親切的簡稱。

ex.en: In the song, a boy named Johnny goes to the beach.
ex.zh: 在這首歌裡，一個名叫強尼的男孩去了海邊。

ex.en: Jordan is a country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 約旦是中東的一個國家。

ex.en: Many tourists visit the ancient city of Petra in Jordan.
ex.zh: 許多遊客到約旦參觀古城佩特拉。

ex.en: Jordan is a name that can be used for both boys and girls.
ex.zh: 喬丹這個名字男孩和女孩都可以使用。

ex.en: The name Jordan also comes from a river in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 喬丹這個名字也源自中東的一條河。

ex.en: Joyce baked a lemon cake for her neighbors.
ex.zh: 喬伊斯為鄰居烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。

ex.en: I'll ask Joyce to help us plan the trip.
ex.zh: 我會請喬伊斯幫我們規劃這趟旅行。

ex.en: The jockey guided the horse smoothly around the last turn.
ex.zh: 騎師穩穩地帶著馬繞過最後一個彎道。

ex.en: A jockey must be light and strong to ride a racehorse.
ex.zh: 騎師必須身輕體健才能騎賽馬。

ex.en: Cars jockeyed for position at the start of the race.
ex.zh: 賽車在比賽起跑時互相爭搶位置。

ex.en: Several candidates are jockeying for the manager's job.
ex.zh: 好幾位候選人正在爭取經理的職位。

ex.en: Joanna is a girl's name used in many countries.
ex.zh: Joanna 是許多國家使用的女孩名字。

ex.en: Joanna works at a bookstore near the station.
ex.zh: 喬安娜在車站附近的書店工作。

ex.en: Everyone was in a jolly mood at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上每個人心情都很愉快。

ex.en: The jolly old man told funny stories all evening.
ex.zh: 那位開朗的老先生整晚都在講有趣的故事。

ex.en: That was a jolly good meal, thank you.
ex.zh: 那頓飯真是太好吃了，謝謝。

ex.en: You did jolly well on the exam.
ex.zh: 你這次考試考得相當好。

ex.en: She has a strong journalistic style.
ex.zh: 她有很鮮明的新聞寫作風格。

ex.en: The magazine is known for high journalistic standards.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌以高標準的新聞專業聞名。
